title: promotions.quote
description: The orders adjuster (kind=discount, STAPEL_ORDERS['ADJUSTERS']['promotions']). Input = the orders adjuster request. Output: {adjustments: [{kind: 'discount', code: <promo code> | 'auto:<promotion key>', label: <promotion name>, amount: negative decimal string (0.00 for the free-shipping marker), line_index: int | null, meta: {issuer: 'promotions', promotion_id, promotion_key, source: 'code'|'automatic', kind, free_shipping: bool, allocation?: [{line_index, amount}]}}], errors: [{code: 'error.<4xx>.promo_code_*', field: 'codes', params: {code, ...}}]}. One adjustment per applied promotion (at most 5). Free shipping is a marker adjustment (amount 0.00, meta.free_shipping true) the shipping adjuster finds in adjustments_so_far and zeroes its line by. No writes.

actor_id.description: The acting account id (a guest's own id, or the account), always sent by orders that know it; user_id stays null for a guest. Owner of this brick's rows; absent from older orders payloads.

context.description: Opaque to orders. promotions reads context.codes: a list of promo code strings (case-insensitive, at most MAX_CODES_PER_CART).
